description: CXOR: two independent digital combining circuits, each multiplying or otherwise combining a pair of stereo signals

params.text: Chooses how the first circuit combines its two inputs, from plain ring modulation through a range of digital combination functions.
Chooses how the second circuit combines its two inputs.
Feeds the output of the first circuit into the A input of the second, so three signals can be combined without a second up and down sampling pass.

inputs.text: The left channel of the first signal into the first circuit.
The right channel of the first signal into the first circuit; with nothing patched the left input feeds both channels.
The left channel of the second signal into the first circuit.
The right channel of the second signal into the first circuit.
The left channel of the first signal into the second circuit.
The right channel of the first signal into the second circuit; with nothing patched the left input feeds both channels.
The left channel of the second signal into the second circuit.
The right channel of the second signal into the second circuit.

outputs.text: The left channel out of the first circuit.
The right channel out of the first circuit.
The left channel out of the second circuit.
The right channel out of the second circuit.

notes: the signal is upsampled before the combination and downsampled after it, which costs four samples of latency.
